podcast.title: Hybrid Genre from Shoegaze Influence
podcast.body: Blackgaze is a genre created when shoegaze techniques were absorbed by other genres, specifically Black Metal. This demonstrated the impact of shoegaze beyond its core adherents, even if the genre itself did not threaten the charts in the 2010s. "Some techniques were absorbed by other genres like Black Metal, creating a sound known as Black Gaze."
